transcript:
Agent: Good morning! Thank you for calling Tech Solutions, this is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi Sarah, I’m having trouble logging into my account. It keeps saying my password is incorrect.

Agent: I’m sorry to hear that! Let’s get that sorted out. Have you tried using the "Forgot Password" option on the login portal?

Customer: Yes, I did, but I never received the reset email. I checked both my inbox and junk folder.

Agent: I understand how frustrating that can be. Could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

Customer: It’s john.doe@email.com.

Agent: Thank you, John. I’ll check our system for any issues with email delivery. One moment please.

Customer: Sure, I hope it’s not a big problem.

Agent: It looks like there was a temporary glitch with our email server, but I’ve manually triggered the reset email. You should receive it shortly!

Customer: Okay, thanks! What if I still can’t log in after that?

Agent: If you're still having issues, I can help you reset your password directly over the phone. Also, have you considered upgrading to our Pro plan? It offers enhanced security features that could help prevent future issues.

Customer: I appreciate the suggestion, but I’m not looking to upgrade right now. I just need access to my account!

Agent: Totally understandable! Let’s focus on getting you back in first. Once you’ve reset your password, let me know if you still need help.

Customer: Will do! Thanks for your help, Sarah. 

Agent: You’re welcome, John! I’m here to assist. Feel free to call back if you need anything else. Have a great day!

Customer: You too! Bye!
